description: Lists the image IDs inside image group (DGS) 8650414, one of the three reels of koha:186990, Ayling's 'Revised register of the soldiers and sailors of New Hampshire in the War of the Rebellion, 1861-1866' (film 2317643). Captured live 2026-11-27 with dev/try-image-search.ts 8650414. Drives ut_search_images_np2: a DGS taken from catalog_search's film notes has real page images, so the agent must not say none are digitized. The substring predicate matches both the bare '8650414' and the zero-padded '008650414'. 1338 images.
